The '''Gungan Bomber''' was a flying creature used by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] to bomb buildings.

==Behind the scenes==
The Gungan Bomber was created for the video-game ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''.
